title: nebula wallet
tagline: wallet that can never be stolen!

prizes.title: Most Likely to be a Startup

description:
helps people be onboarded easily without the hassle of managing private keys, it's as simple as using your device's biometrics to generate a wallet and verify transactions using your fingerpring or face ID. gives crypto a much more familiar UX and aims at reducing the friction 10 folds for overall better experience for the users.
